measurement: whole-process semantic workload latency after build
notes: Build time is excluded from measured process latency.
Every warmup and measured process must reproduce the frozen semantic digest.
The JVM and CLR are new processes for every sample, so JIT/startup remains part of this metric.
This protocol is useful for reproducibility and process/startup behavior, not a claim about steady-state transaction-kernel throughput.
Kernel-throughput ranking remains disabled until equivalent in-process timing boundaries exist for Merit, Java, and C#.
